The invite-code helper _new_invite_code is now the only random-source touchpoint; good candidate to move into a small utils/security.py alongside future crypto helpers.

AuthContext / RigContext value now correctly memoised, but the dependency arrays should be spot-checked: consumers relying on referential stability of nested objects (e.g. user.subscription_status) will still re-render if the entire user object is replaced on refresh — expected, not a bug.

Advisory modal on /equipment blocks pointer events on first paint (already noted iter10) — sat in the way of automated CRUD until dismissed. Not a regression but a persistent UX friction for scripted flows and possibly for first-time users on slow connections.
